behaviors.name: Candle
behaviors.intent: Someone is up there with a candle.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.scale = (0.9, 1.5, 1)
  self.mesh.emissive = color(1, 0.55, 0.2, 0.6 + sin(time * 7) * 0.2 + random() * 0.25)
end

behaviors.name: Walk
behaviors.intent: Walk slowly up the path toward the manor door, a little unsteady.
behaviors.source:
behavior Walk
  var speed = 0.85
  on tick
    if self.position.z > -12 then
      move self by (sin(time * 0.8) * 0.18 * dt, 0, -speed * dt)
    end
    self.position.y = abs(sin(time * 4.4)) * 0.05
  end
end

behaviors.name: Swing
behaviors.intent: Swing gently with each step.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.rotation = (sin(time * 4.4) * 7, 0, sin(time * 2.2) * 10)
end

behaviors.name: Haunt
behaviors.intent: Drift in slow loops over the graveyard, bobbing, always turned toward its path.
behaviors.source:
behavior Haunt
  var home = (0, 0, 0)
  on start
    home = self.position
  end
  on tick
    let a = time * 0.32
    self.position = home + (cos(a) * 4.2, sin(time * 1.6) * 0.25, sin(a) * 3.4)
    self.rotation = (0, 0 - a * 57.3, sin(time * 2) * 6)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Shimmer
behaviors.intent: Breathe in and out of visibility.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.color = color(0.87, 0.94, 1, 0.33 + sin(time * 2.6) * 0.14)
end

behaviors.name: Blink
behaviors.intent: Watch from the trees; blink at random.
behaviors.source:
behavior Blink
  var shut = 0
  on tick
    if chance(0.008) then
      shut = 0.16
    end
    shut = max(0, shut - dt)
    if shut > 0 then
      self.scale = (1, 0.08, 1)
    else
      self.scale = (1, 1, 1)
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Circle
behaviors.intent: Circle the east tower, dipping and climbing.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let a = time * self.speed + self.phase
  self.position = (self.cx + cos(a) * self.r, self.h + sin(a * 3) * 0.5, self.cz + sin(a) * self.r)
  self.rotation = (0, 0 - a * 57.3, sin(a * 3) * 15)
end

behaviors.name: Flicker
behaviors.intent: Flicker like a real flame.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.light.intensity = 2.7 + sin(time * 13) * 0.25 + random() * 0.6
end

behaviors.name: Storm
behaviors.intent: Every few seconds there may be a lightning flash: a sharp double flicker.
behaviors.source:
behavior Storm
  var flash = 0
  on tick
    every 3.5 seconds
      if chance(0.55) then
        flash = 1
      end
    end
    self.light.intensity = flash * 5 * (0.55 + 0.45 * sin(time * 70))
    flash = max(0, flash - dt * 3)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Follow
behaviors.intent: Follow behind the wanderer's shoulder, looking up the path at the manor.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let p = find("Wanderer")
  if exists(p) then
    self.position = lerp(self.position, p.position + (1.5, 2.3, 4.6), 0.06)
    look self at p.position + (0, 1.8, -9)
  end
end
